anchor_value: Source SOI interest-rate cells populated, including all-PIK rates such as 14.55 % PIK, 12.44 % PIK, and 13.25 % PIK

findings.detail: All-PIK private-credit SOI rows carry explicit interest-rate cells, but the extracted holdings rows surfaced by X02 have blank interest_rate and basis_spread.

rationale: X02 flags PRIVATE_CREDIT rows where the stored interest_rate and basis_spread are blank. The raw SOI schedule has explicit Index, Spread, and Interest Rate columns, and all-PIK credit rows contain populated Interest Rate cells such as 14.55 % PIK, 12.44 % PIK, and 13.25 % PIK. A blank extracted rate for these credit positions is therefore an extraction gap rather than a source limitation or aggregate anchor issue.
